summary: Sprint 01 (Production Inspection + Evidence Foundation) end-to-end acceptance pass. 39/41 pytest cases green (2 failures are real envelope-vs-status-code bugs — see backend.critical). Sprint 00 smoke + Sprint 01 smoke both pass with no regression. Frontend Playwright verifies the full inspector journey across BOTH tenants (TENANT-000001 + RIYADAH-DOH-001) including create/upload/submit/access-link, tenant chip switching, and tenant data isolation. No new mocked APIs.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 422 instead of the spec-required HTTP 400 for VALIDATION_ERROR. Envelope body IS correct ({success:false, errors:[{code:'VALIDATION_ERROR', field:'references.externalVehicleRef', ...}]}) but DI-0034 + AC-DI-S01-002 require status 400. Root cause: a Pydantic Field constraint (e.g. min_length, required) raises RequestValidationError, which a global exception handler converts to the correct envelope but keeps FastAPI's default 422. Fix: in the RequestValidationError handler, return JSONResponse(status_code=400, ...) for VALIDATION_ERROR code.
Returns HTTP 422 instead of HTTP 400. Same root cause as above (Pydantic ge/le constraints). Spec requires 400 VALIDATION_ERROR per AC-DI-S01-009. Envelope body is correct.

rca of the issue: Both backend failures share a single root cause: when Pydantic rejects a payload (Field min_length, ge/le, missing required field), FastAPI raises RequestValidationError. The app already has an exception handler that maps this to the proper envelope {code:'VALIDATION_ERROR', field, message}, but it forwards FastAPI's default HTTP 422. DI-0034 / AC-DI-S01-002 require HTTP 400 for any envelope whose primary error code is VALIDATION_ERROR. Mitigation: in the RequestValidationError handler (likely in /app/backend/api/middleware/error_handlers.py or wherever validation errors are caught), construct JSONResponse(status_code=400, content=envelope) instead of inheriting the framework's 422. No other tests need updating.
